description: SPENDS CREDITS, about one per audio minute (less if already transcribed). The default way to get a transcript: pass one episode — an Apple Podcasts or YouTube link, feed_url with guid, episode_id, upload_id, or path. Returns it a page at a time (next_page), or a job_id for read_transcript while it runs. max_credits caps the spend; repeating a call never charges twice.

episode_id.description: From list_episodes, with that show's feed_url and itunes_id.

feed_url.description: With guid: an RSS feed and one item. With episode_id: that show's feed.

itunes_id.description: With episode_id, as list_episodes took it.

max_credits.description: Refuse if it could cost more.

page_start.description: A later page: the answer's next_page.

path.description: An audio file on this machine, by absolute path.

url.description: An Apple Podcasts episode link, or a YouTube video link.

name: transcribe
title: Transcribe an episode
